title: Shaam haye shaam
body:
Shaam haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya hussain..(4)
Shaam ka bazaar kuja, abid e beemar kuja..(2)
zainab e dilgeer kuja, majma e aghyaar kuja
<<MINI>>
haye shaam, haye shaam, haye shaam..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri ummat ke zewar pehenkar..(2)
mere nana chali hu mai shaam
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Mai deti kafan tujhko bhayya
gar sar pe rida mere hoti
gar hote khule haath mere
tere zakhmo ko hatho se dhoti
pa bande rasan sar barehna..(2)
dekho bhayya chali hu mai shaam
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jis zainab ko tumne baradar
kabhi nazre utha kar na dekha
haath rassi se mere bandhe hai aur sar par nahi mere parda
kaise kufe mein jaungi ghaazi..(2)
jab balwe mein aayega naam
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaise darbaar paas aa raha hai
mera dil doobta jaa raha hai
mai to ghar mein bhi kam bolti thi
bhai tumko to sab kuch pata hai
kis tarha se karegi bata de..(2)
ek sharabi se zainab kalaam..
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dil ye kehta hai ro ro ke bhayya
kaash abbas maujood hota
kaat deta wo uski zaba'n ko
koi baaghi agar mujhko kehta
dekhti phir mai kis tarha leta..(2)
koi zainab ka majme mein naam
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Keh rahe hai ye has has ke shaami
aane wale hai darbaar baaghi
jisne ajdaad maare hamare
aa rahi hai yaha uski beti
kholta paani pheko chhato se..(2)
patharo ka karo intezaam
<<MINI>>
shham haye shaam
haye shaam, haye shaam, haye shaam..(2)
